contract.requestEvidence: version=1, exact original query, ordered scopes with integer UTF-16 start/end, exact text, status, target and optional exact operator span

invariants: Source text, bounds, token boundaries, order and complete coverage are validated; no overlap, hidden or split metadata mention.
Canonical data values, metadata identity and geometry context stay locally validated; scopes cannot supply series IDs.
Direct supported data exclusions cannot be relabeled positive. Negating knowledge cannot itself exclude data.
Non-exclusion does not imply positive request; undecided requests remain unresolved.
Positive projection retains source positions and punctuation; it cannot create a metadata phrase absent from raw source.
Unrepresentable scoped constraints, conflicting dispositions and incompatible requested frequencies require clarification.

Unsupported deterministic grammar requires clarification while preserving independently established requests. This is the newly authorized rules-only behavior, not a change to the frozen query meanings.
Valid model evidence is independently revalidated after actual browser serialization against raw q; stale/missing/corrupt evidence cannot become authoritative derived arrays.
Scope semantics proposed by a model remain fallible; structural validation does not certify universal language understanding.
The current model, country repair, UI/auth, retrieval, units, dependencies and offline transport policy are preserved.
disputes: Bare Georgia follows the user's actual existing state/country context rule; a review expectation of unconditional ambiguity is not controlling.
Not entirely include, no need, and do not exclude do not have unconditional full-exclusion meanings; original fixtures and independent adjudications remain available.
